text: 中国工商银行副行长王景武在该行2026年中期业绩发布会上表示，工行坚持稳中求进、提质增效，紧密围绕国家战略，做好全量资产布局，优化信贷结构，扎实推进资产质量管控各项工作，集团资产质量的核心指标稳中向好，2026年6月末，不良率为1.29%，较年初下降了2个基点，高质量发展的基础进一步巩固。
text_en: Wang Jingwu, vice president of ICBC, said at the bank's 2026 interim results conference that ICBC adheres to steady progress and quality improvement, closely follows national strategies, optimizes full-asset allocation, refines credit structure, and solidly advances asset quality management. The group's core asset quality metrics improved steadily, with the NPL ratio at 1.29% as of end-June 2026, down 2 basis points from the start of the year, further consolidating the foundation for high-quality development.
